name: acos-graf-load-test
description: Acos GRAF - Load Test: K6 performance testing framework for WebSak Plus (modular Create Sak & Journal Post scenarios)

scripts.__comment_sak_desc: Tests for creating WebSak cases with various load patterns
scripts.__comment_sak_smoke: Smoke test: Quick validation with 1 user, 1 case creation
scripts.__comment_sak_load: Load test: Sustained load with multiple users creating cases
scripts.__comment_sak_stress: Stress test: Push system beyond normal capacity to find breaking points
scripts.__comment_sak_spike: Spike test: Sudden traffic spikes to test system resilience
scripts.__comment_sak_endurance: Endurance test: Extended duration test to check for memory leaks and stability
scripts.__comment_sak_nopace: No-pacing variants: Run tests without think time (maximum throughput)
scripts.__comment_jp_desc: Tests for creating single Journal Posts with various load patterns
scripts.__comment_jp_smoke: Smoke test: Quick validation with 1 user, 1 JP creation
scripts.__comment_jp_load: Load test: Sustained load with multiple users creating JPs
scripts.__comment_jp_stress: Stress test: Push system beyond normal capacity for JP creation
scripts.__comment_jp_spike: Spike test: Sudden traffic spikes for JP creation
scripts.__comment_jp_endurance: Endurance test: Extended JP creation to check stability
scripts.__comment_jp_nopace: No-pacing variants: JP tests without think time (maximum throughput)
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc: === Create Single JP with Multiple Documents Tests ===
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc_desc: Tests for creating a single Journal Post with multiple document attachments
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc_smoke: Smoke test: 1 JP with multiple documents attached
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc_load: Load test: Multiple users creating JPs with document attachments
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc_stress: Stress test: High volume JP+documents creation
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc_spike: Spike test: Sudden spikes in JP+documents creation
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc_endurance: Endurance test: Extended JP+documents creation for stability
scripts.__comment_jp_multidoc_nopace: No-pacing variants: JP+documents tests without think time
scripts.__comment_multiplejp: === Create Multiple JPs (Incoming & Outgoing) with Multiple Documents Tests ===
scripts.__comment_multiplejp_smoke: Smoke test: 2 incoming + 2 outgoing JPs with 10 large test documents each (1MB-10MB files)
scripts.test:create-multiplejp-with-multiple-doc: k6 run -e SCENARIO=smoke_test -e INCOMING_COUNT=2 -e OUTGOING_COUNT=2 -e USE_TEST_DOCS=true tests/api/journalposts/create-multiplejp-with-multiple-document.js
scripts.__comment_multiplejp_synthetic: Smoke test: 2 incoming + 2 outgoing JPs with 3 synthetic documents each (fast, lightweight)
scripts.test:create-multiplejp-with-multiple-doc: k6 run -e SCENARIO=smoke_test -e INCOMING_COUNT=2 -e OUTGOING_COUNT=2 -e DOC_COUNT=3 -e USE_TEST_DOCS=false tests/api/journalposts/create-multiplejp-with-multiple-document.js
scripts.__comment_multiplejp_load: Load test: Multiple incoming/outgoing JPs with large test documents (realistic performance testing)
scripts.__comment_multiplejp_stress: Stress test: High volume JPs creation with large documents to test system limits
scripts.__comment_reports_desc: Commands for viewing and managing test reports
scripts.report:open: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path src/reports/create-sak-report.html) { Start-Process src/reports/create-sak-report.html } else { Write-Host 'Report not found. Run a test first.' }"
scripts.report:open:jp: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path src/reports/create-jp-report.html) { Start-Process src/reports/create-jp-report.html } else { Write-Host 'JP Report not found. Run a test first.' }"
scripts.report:list: Get-ChildItem src/reports/*-report.html -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object Name,LastWriteTime
scripts.__comment_dev_desc: Linting, formatting, and project setup commands
